origin.description: Convert strings from one encoding to another.
origin.usage: stri_encode(str, from = NULL, to = NULL, to_raw = FALSE)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, a raw vector, or a list of raw vectors.

arguments.name: from
arguments.text: NULL uses the declared mark for text and the default charset for raw. A name reads the stored bytes in that encoding.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: NULL is the default charset. Otherwise one encoding name.

arguments.name: to_raw
arguments.text: TRUE returns a list of raw vectors.

origin.details: A code point that cannot be encoded warns and becomes byte 0x1A. Ill-formed UTF-8 input warns and becomes U+FFFD. to_raw FALSE rejects an embedded NUL. A missing input is NA, or NULL when to_raw is TRUE.
origin.value: A character vector, or a list of raw vectors.
origin.example:
x <- as.integer(stri_encode("\u0105", to = "ISO-8859-2", to_raw = TRUE)[[1]])
cat(paste0("stri_encode(\"ą\", to = \"ISO-8859-2\", to_raw = TRUE) returns byte ", x, ".\n"))

translation.description: Convert strings from one encoding to another.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, bytes, a list of strings, or a list of byte vectors. None is one missing value for a raw checker and an empty character vector for text.

arguments.name: from_
arguments.text: None uses the Unicode text, or the default charset for bytes. A name reads those bytes in that encoding.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: None is the default charset. Otherwise one encoding name.

arguments.name: to_raw
arguments.text: True returns lists of integer byte values 0..255.

translation.details: A code point that cannot be encoded warns and becomes byte 0x1A. Ill-formed UTF-8 input warns and becomes U+FFFD. to_raw False rejects an embedded NUL. UTF-8, US-ASCII, latin1, and the native charset come back as text. Other charsets come back as bytes. A missing input is NA, or None when to_raw is true.
translation.value: A string, bytes, NA, or None. A list returns a list. to_raw true returns lists of ints.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_encode
x = stri_encode("ą", to="ISO-8859-2", to_raw=True)
print(f"stri_encode(\"ą\", to=\"ISO-8859-2\", to_raw=True) returns byte {x[0]}.")
